column1: # THE IMAGEGEN DOWNLOAD MANIFEST. One row per FILE a tier needs, pinned by
# repository REVISION (a commit, never a branch), sha256 and byte size.
# Files are fetched on first use into cache_root()/models/imagegen/<tier>/
# through the enclave proxy only, sha256-verified on the host before they are
# kept. A digest mismatch discards the file. Formats: .safetensors or .gguf
# only (a pickle checkpoint can execute code on load).
# Licences re-verified 2026-10-29 on the Hugging Face API (cardData.license,
#                            sd.cpp's docs/distilled_sd.md names; sha256 equals the
#                            sdxs09 file measured on lenovinha and yoga 2026-10-27)
#                            its ae.safetensors lfs sha256 is byte-identical to the
#                            GATED black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-schnell one, so no gated
#                            file is needed; the one repo carries transformer, ae,
#                            T5-XXL and CLIP-L, as tiers.tsv licence_source requires)
# A tier with no row here cannot be fetched (tier_unavailable).
#   tier      I0..I3, a row of tiers.tsv
#   role      model | diffusion_model | vae | clip_l | t5xxl  (the sd-cli flag the
#             file is passed as: a full checkpoint is --model; FLUX is four files,
#   file      path inside the repository (also the cached file name's basename)
# 1957-pins (operator standing approval 2026-11-01; 1954-gdi6 control_net/loras): aux rows. The tier column is <base tier>/<folder>; they are fetched only when a request names them.

# 1956-bh6j (studio-asset-pipeline design D4): the ComfyUI studio's weights, read from the Hub API and the resolve headers on 2026-11-02 by calmecacpilli. The tier column is the folder the studio's extra_model_paths.yaml maps under /models; role studio:<kind> rows are aux (never part of a tier download, fetched only when a studio workflow names them). Union needs no new folder beyond controlnet.

# 1982-kpin (kumbia-kombat studio weights; STAGED, a draft PR until the operator confirms the licences first-hand). Read from the Hub API and resolve headers 2026-11-03 by lenovinha. Comfy-Org split_files are the single-file ComfyUI repackages of the named repos (same weights where both exist: the Wan bf16 and FLUX.2-klein sha256 equal the originals); fp8 so each diffusion model fits a 24 GB GPU.
